format: Each row corresponds to exp26/anc27 source array position. [ingredientIndex1,ingredientIndex2,statusCode,methodCode,flagString]. Index -1 means HOLD/no plausible recipe; 0 candidate; 1 review; 2 blocked. Global ingredient indices are zero-based in concatenated sourceOrder arrays. All statuses are unverified and need item-specific editorial review. For exp26 method code 1=manual exception,2=name derived,3=topic schematic; refer to source exp26_logic_proposals_v1.json for original method explanations.
instructions: Use this SINGLE file as the handoff. Load sourceOrder files relative to merged/. ALL 1999 proposed decisions are encoded here; no second handoff file is needed.
Do not mistake provisional years/ds for actual invention dates. Existing source_required fields mean item-specific sources missing.
Decode rows by sourceOrder and recompute recipes after editorial corrections; cross-check content IDs, existence, temporal order, and collision across all 2917 items.
Neither exp26 999 items nor anc27 1000 items has item-level historical verification. Keep original factual text with appropriate uncertainty until you can provide museum/primary-science citations.

Per item write distinct educational function, manufacturing sequence, materials, effects/limitations, region/date caveats, reliable source URLs. Do not invent facts/citations or claim all 1999 sourced.
New anc27 species/domestication and culturally distinct scripts should be independent branches with actual raw species/specific knowledge; HOLD is preferable to wrong pair.
Reject anachronistic species-to-region transfers, material substitutions (bronze/iron), historical cross-civilization chains, and conflicts with existing 1917 base/exp26 items.
Treat duplicateMatches as REQUIRES HUMAN DECISION, not automatic deletion. Preserve true regional or material variants with clearly distinct function.

Integrate only approved recipes and content; no mandatory second route. Keep 918 base nodes unchanged. Expand data build validation, sources, graph topological ordering, mode coverage, accessibility and gameplay smoke tests.

All modes: Main game, Reverse, Minimum Path, Archaeology, Survival, Escape Room need explicit tests; Civilization, Decipher, Alien Archaeology, and Museum have separate policies and require purposeful integrations rather than fabricated participation.
For art: inspect recognizable profile at normal scale and 3D-spinning wireframe. anc27 has 0 approved art models; generate and manually validate before publication.

Never automatically publish or merge to main; work on review branch. Summarize completed, blocked, source coverage, working merge candidates, duplicate decisions, QA results and production deployment.
